articles.title: China shows way in new pharma race: Own meds, don’t just make ’em
articles.summary: Pharmaceutical geopolitics is usually mapped through factories. China’s vast pharmaceutical supply chain, India’s strength in low-cost generics and the concentration of patented drug discovery in richer economies have shaped that discussion for years. But that map is becoming incomplete. Two developments in China this past week point to the next layer of competition. articles.title: Hollow Promises: Resetting Gaza’s Ceasefire

articles.title: Curbing Reprisals in Syria
articles.summary: Fuelled by wartime grievances, mob attacks and other forms of retribution threaten Syria’s transition. Damascus has done too little to deter such acts.
